domain: clamp_range: [x,lo,hi] with lo<=hi, clamp x into [lo,hi]; second_largest: int list with >=2 distinct values, second largest distinct; count_even: int list, count of even values; running_max: nonempty int list, running maximum list; first_above: [values,limit], first v in values with v>limit else null
score: exact JSON equality, 80 equal-weight cases, 16 per task
promotion: candidate total strictly increases AND each task pass count does not decrease
